claims.claim_ar: «بلى» حرف جواب وتصديق واستئناف، يستعمل لتأكيد ما بعده وإثباته
claims.claim_en: The particle 'bala' functions as an affirmative response/confirmation and a resumption, used to emphatically confirm what follows.
claims.needs_review_reason: Based on the Darwish I'rab commentary excerpt; verify against specialized balagha sources (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, etc.) if required for classical rhetorical labeling.
claims.rhetorical_effect: emphatic reassurance and affirmation; resumes the discourse and strengthens the subsequent conditional assurance
